Long Title: An Act to provide for facilitation of inclusive growth and slum-free cities,including basic amenities and affordable housing to the slum-dwellersfor this purpose to lay down general principles applicable to slum-free cities in all spheres of Government, to define the functions of State and Local Governments in respect of according property rights to slum dwellers and to provide Property Rights to SIum Dwellers, and matter connected or incidental thereto.
